facts.claim: Earth spins in 24 hours, Mars in 25, Jupiter in 10.

source.title: NASA Space Place: How long is one day on other planets?
source.quote: Earth takes 24 hours to complete one spin, and Mars takes 25 hours. The gas giants rotate really fast. Jupiter takes just 10 hours to complete one rotation.

facts.source_sentence: Earth takes 24 hours to complete one spin, and Mars takes 25 hours. The gas giants rotate really fast. Jupiter takes just 10 hours to complete one rotation.

facts.claim: Venus takes 5,832 hours to spin round once, the longest of the planets in NASA's table.

source.title: NASA Space Place: How long is one day on other planets?
source.quote: On Mercury a day lasts 1,408 hours, and on Venus it lasts 5,832 hours.

facts.source_sentence: On Mercury a day lasts 1,408 hours, and on Venus it lasts 5,832 hours.
